name: Raspberry Pi Pico (original, non-W)
record_note: The original non-W Pico provides 2 MiB QSPI flash at the RP2040 XIP base 0x10000000 and a 12 MHz crystal. GPIO23, GPIO24, GPIO25, and GPIO29 are used by on-board SMPS, USB sensing, LED, and VSYS measurement. The XIP linker layout, board revision, build profile, and SWD/USB flash profile remain open.

qspi_xip_flash.notes: RP2040 XIP window begins at 0x10000000. Board flash capacity is 2 MiB; reserve boot2 and SDK/application partitions in the eventual linker profile.
